headline: Analysts highlight top jewellery stocks for long-term growth
hook: Jewellery stocks rally ahead of festive season
summary: Jewellery stocks are trending higher as gold prices recover and festive and wedding demand expectations rise. Market analysts have identified Titan, Kalyan Jewellers, Shanti Gold, and Shringar House of Mangalsutra as potential long-term picks. Investors are advised to focus on company execution and market-share expansion rather than just seasonal trends. This sector remains a key play for those looking to capitalize on India's wedding and festival consumption cycle.
why_it_matters: Festive demand could boost earnings for major jewellery retailers.
winners_losers: Jewellery retailers gain / consumers face higher gold costs

headline: Angel One releases eight stock recommendations for Samvat 2083
hook: Brokerage picks for the new Samvat year
summary: Angel One has identified eight stocks for the upcoming Samvat 2083, projecting potential upsides of up to 32%. The list includes ICICI Bank, Northern Arc Capital, Aarti Pharmalabs, Shanti Gold International, Ratnaveer Precision Engineering, Engineers India, AGI Infra, and Apollo Micro Systems. These recommendations are timed for the traditional Muhurat trading session. Retail investors should note these are broker-specific research calls.
why_it_matters: Brokerage research may influence short-term price action for these specific stocks.

headline: Shanti Gold International shares drop 15% intraday
hook: Sharp intraday decline for Shanti Gold
summary: Shanti Gold International experienced a significant 15% price drop during intraday trading. The sudden decline follows recent volatility in the stock's performance. Retail investors should note that such sharp moves in small-cap stocks often involve low liquidity and high risk. The company has not yet issued a formal clarification regarding the specific trigger for this price action.
why_it_matters: High volatility in small-cap stocks risks significant capital loss.

headline: Shanti Gold International releases investor presentation
hook: Routine investor deck released by Shanti Gold
summary: Shanti Gold International Limited has submitted an investor presentation to the stock exchange. The filing contains standard corporate disclosures and business updates provided for shareholder information. Retail investors can review the presentation for operational metrics and future outlook details.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update offers minor insight into company operations

headline: Shantigold releases standalone and consolidated financial results for Q2 FY27
summary: Shantigold's board met on November 3, 2026, to review and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This filing provides retail investors with the latest operational and financial performance figures for the company. Reviewing these quarterly metrics helps stakeholders assess revenue growth, profit margins, and overall financial health. Shareholders can evaluate these numbers to guide their investment decisions for the company.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings figures guide your view on company valuation.

headline: FIIs raise stakes in select stocks, pushing prices up to 135% higher in three months
hook: Foreign funds reverse two quarters of selling
summary: Foreign institutional investors turned net buyers in select Indian equities during the September 2026 quarter following two consecutive quarters of reduced exposure. Companies including Morepen Laboratories and Shanti Gold International rallied up to 135% over the three-month period. This shift signals renewed institutional interest in specific market segments after a phase of capital withdrawal. Indian retail investors tracking institutional flows can use these sector shifts to evaluate momentum in mid-cap and small-cap stocks.
why_it_matters: Renewed foreign inflows can spark momentum in select mid-caps.
winners_losers: FII-backed stocks gain / capital-outflow sectors hurt

headline: Jewellery shares jump as gold ETF subscriptions limited
hook: Gold ETF curbs lift jewellery stocks
summary: Shanti Gold International, PC Jeweller and Sky Gold & Diamonds rose up to 10% on Friday. The rally followed a temporary restriction on new subscriptions to gold ETF Fund of Funds by mutual fund houses. Analysts expect the upcoming festive and wedding season to sustain gold demand. Retail jewellery chains may capture additional market share.
why_it_matters: Gold ETF restrictions lift jewellery stocks, boosting sector earnings.
